entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I humbly ask that you cast your vote for[n]me, Masayoshi Shido!

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Let us all set sail toward a happy future[n]together!

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I hope to continue serving you all!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is that the guy!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You guys wait here! I'll go get intel for us!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Wait!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heeey! Yo, Shido-san!

entries.speaker: Bodyguard
entries.en: Stand back!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I just wanna talk to him for a sec!

entries.speaker: Bodyguard
entries.en: He's a busy man!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell!? Ain't he s'posed to hear a[n]citizen's comments!?

entries.speaker: Bodyguard
entries.en: That's enough, brat!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're that asshole we met at the hotel[n]before! At the elevators!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry. So you can butt in front of[n]other people if you're in a hurry?

entries.speaker: Bodyguard
entries.en: What are you talking about!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That moron!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Come on, stop!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But, these guys—

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Hey kid.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: You don't want to know what happens[n]when you cross me...
That voice...

entries.speaker: Distinguished Man
entries.en: It seems the customer base has changed[n]since I was here last. Have they started[n]a day care?

entries.speaker: Drunk Man
entries.en: This ain't a show. Get lost, kid.

entries.speaker: Drunk Man
entries.en: Damn brat! I'll sue!
This man...
There's no mistake... He's the same[n]man as the one from before...

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: What are you looking at?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: This country is filled with clueless[n]children... I worry for Japan's future.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Let them go. My next appointment is[n]coming up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What a piece of shit. So whaddya think[n]after seein' him in person?
He's why I got arrested.
He's the one who accused me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... He's the jerk you told us about[n]before!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The same guy!? For real!? Seriously!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You're sure... aren't you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shido's the one who ruined your life...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit... I don't believe it...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Let's get going, okay?
